provenance: Hand-authored 2026-08-19 for the CTO-authorized M11 Judge v3 implementation. claim: The company expects revenue growth next quarter.
evidence: Management is confident that sales will rise significantly in the coming quarter, driven by robust order volumes.
reference_rationale: Same entity and period (implied continuity of 'the company'/'management', 'coming quarter' = 'next quarter'), same property (sales/revenue) -- clears all four applicability tests. 'Sales will rise significantly' is a paraphrase of 'revenue growth', and 'confident' affirms an expectation, matching the claim's proposition despite non-identical wording. SUPPORTED.
